name: Small zooplankton
description: The tiny grazing animals of the open water: microzooplankton (2-200 micrometres) and mesozooplankton (200-2000 micrometres) such as copepods. Functional group pooling the source's microzooplankton and mesozooplankton compartments, which were measured separately but feed on phytoplankton and are eaten by the same predators; pooled to bring the 49-compartment model within this atlas's 25-node ceiling.
